i1_keyword_anonymization.description: Rust grammar keywords (fn,let,if,else,for,return,use,match) renamed to pseudo-words (zorf,klim,trin,plor,wexil,yalp,brivo,sceld) in the prompt; ordinary identifiers and stdlib names left intact. Model asked to write anonymized-keyword pseudo-code then produce a compilable real Rust translation.

seeds.expected_note: internally consistent geometry computation validated by re-deriving from generated source; program compiled and ran deterministically

i2_vocabulary_anonymization.description: I1 keyword anonymization plus stdlib/builtin vocabulary anonymization (println! -> shout!, Vec<T> -> Stak<T>, .len() -> .tally(), range -> span(a,b), .sort() -> .arrange(), HashMap -> Chart, .insert() -> .stow, .get() -> .peek, .rev() -> .flip, .collect() -> .gather). Model asked to translate anonymized spec into compilable real Rust using the real stdlib names.

seeds.task: sort vec, print len and debug vec

seeds.stdout: a: 3, b: 2, c: 1 (order arbitrary, all counts correct)

seeds.task: vec sort descending via rev+collect, print len and debug vec

evidence.methodology: llm_learnability I1/I2 per llm_learnability.md and primary.json: keyword_anonymization_seeds=3, vocabulary_anonymization_seeds=3, fresh session per trial, max_repair_turns=3 (not needed, all seeds passed on first completion).
evidence.toolchain: rustc 1.95.0 verified via direct run action (rustc --version, exit 0) and via compiling+running hello.rs (exit 0, stdout '3') prior to any trial_start.
evidence.trial_artifacts: raw prompts/completions preserved verbatim under trials/<id>/ by the runtime; compile/run evidence reproduced by score.py (script) and independently confirmed via the toolchain run actions listed above; per-trial compiled binaries retained under work_<trial_id>/.
